    Morning briefing

    Morning briefing

    The share column ships flat at the room's median - 10 names, 1 of them short, their order an unshipped shadow (R81) - and the option column ships the room's own G_OPTION median on 10 legs (R79; the owner's ten a day - 0 DESK-FILLED, 6 R4-OVERFLOW (owner, 2026-10-06) at half stake), led by CSCO 2026-10-16 $112C at 50.0; watchdog sits suspended on a congressional feed that still serves no record count, and the board sat after the open

    Executive summary

    Mandate: Mix (any). EXPOSURE share +0.4995 [n=10] / option -0.098 [n=10] (SEAT-COMPUTED: Spearman with average ranks, the gate's vector against each shipped line's served pct_change_1d signed by its direction). TAPE-CALL=CONTINUATION FALSIFIER=MRVL, NTAP and AVGO, the share column's first three in the persisted order, close the window below their freeze marks 271.0, 233.34 and 364.31 KEY=slate_packet.json candidates[].price and candidates[].pct_change_1d. The share EXPOSURE sits at the 0.50 line, so I credit no edge to the share column's order: it is the move into the freeze as much as the room's judgment. OVERNIGHT: Asia closed mixed - the Hang Seng +1.79% and Shanghai +0.05% closed up, while the Nikkei -1.42% and KOSPI -2.62% rows are stale bars from 2026-10-08; Europe is up in session (FTSE 100 +1.08%, DAX +1.18%, Euro Stoxx 50 +0.90%) and the futures read +0.37% (S&P 500) and +0.27% (Nasdaq 100), so Europe and the futures agreed on an up open. This board sat after the open: at the 11:17:23 freeze SPY is 777.33 (+0.44), QQQ +0.29, IWM +0.42 and ^VIX 14.99 (-2.73), and the court scores the tape from the freeze to the close. Expected shape: a straight session from the freeze, SPY holding above its freeze mark 777.33 into the close - a lean, not a certainty; the stale Asian rows are the disagreement that most often retraces, and the 10-year at 5.28 (+0.86%) is the headwind that would turn it. REGIME: mixed - SPY +1.0% over 5d with every index trend flat, VIX 15.0 falling, the dollar index 102.30; the cycle read projects +2.32% over the next 10 trading days, which I treat as approximate. CONVICTION is thin and I say so: no share one-median sits above 52.5 (GOOGL) and no contract median above 52.0 (WMT, MRVL). The option column is ten legs on one expiry, 2026-10-16, 9 long calls and 1 put (STX): one bet on next week's tape, not ten. In the share column MRVL, NTAP, AVGO and SMCI are one AI-hardware bet, ranked as one by their medians (52.0, 50.5, 50.0, 48.5). What invalidates the day's top ideas: SPY closing below 777.33, and for the option column's top three, closes below 111.79 (CSCO), 68.63 (UBER) and 333.95 (GOOGL). ONE-DATE BOOK: 2026-10-16 holds 7.0 of 7.0 option units. HOUSE RULES (decided before the freeze-to-close window, never mid-session): (1) STAKES - shares flat at 1.0 per line (R81); options at option_default 1.0 on the first four legs and the desk's half stake on the six R4-OVERFLOW legs, with no chair override on any leg (R129); the book is one date and 9 calls of 10 legs, so it is sized as one bet. (2) EXITS - every option leg exits at its own R66 token: ratchet at its break-even, kill on a close through the house-bracket stop on the underlying, else close 2026-10-15; every share line dies on its printed kill close, actioned at the next session's open. (3) WINDFALL - a leg whose premium closes at 2 x its premium at the freeze banks half at the first mark the desk serves for that contract and trails the rest; no second ticket on a name with an unexited winner, and no add mid-session. Desk, R92/R12 - the memo's listings against the persisted book: share: PASS; option: DIFF PRINTED (R92)

    How this document was produced

    Live board session: FIFTEEN graders - the Decoder on its sheet number 11 - then the Skeptic and the Executive, each a separate model call over the same forty-candidate packet, answering the app's own prompts with each seat's most recent Evening Court lessons prepended. Collector data is real and timestamped. THE PACKET FROZE AT 11:17:23 ET, WITH 282 MINUTES OF TAPE LEFT BEFORE THE CLOSE: every entry is an early-afternoon mark, not an open, and under R14 a window that short makes seat ranks advisory.
